SOURCE.description: Review the exact selected source, rendition parity, illustration rights, historical editions and author decisions for all five readers.

CATALOG.description: Verify exact archive, filter and reading-path behavior before and after recording observed site publication dates.

REVIEW.description: Record completed source-bound independent reviewer passes and any required corrections.

BROWSER.description: Verify all exact hosted readers in desktop and mobile, including no-JavaScript reading, images, canonical, sitemap and social metadata.

RELEASE.description: Verify source-bound preview, stable staging and production plus author decisions and recorded live publication events.

CLOSEOUT.description: Report the approved five URLs, sources, effort, blockers and reusable steps, then stop for the author decision.
